annotations.text:
WHAT SHIPS  ·  every artboard on this page titled CHOSEN. The two comparison sheets show rejected options beside the chosen one -- read their titles.

LESSON  ·  rail (rail green) / paper column / explainer (field green). Kept: colour fields, drop cap, crest, margin annotation. Cut: repp stripe, varsity numerals, ribbon, stamped seal.

CHECKPOINT  ·  C, the margin question, is CHOSEN. A paper card, B torn slip, D index card are rejected -- B stays with homework, D is parked.

CHECKPOINT AT 390px  ·  P1, the lead-in line, is CHOSEN. P2 tinted band and P3 rule-as-container are rejected.

MATERIALS  ·  paper column reads, photocopy sheet practises (homework + all three refresher grains), blue book examines. Blue book interior is on a 30px rhythm with type on the rules.

PARKED, NOT DISCARDED  ·  legal pad for v1.1 notes; index card unassigned; torn slip stays with homework.

Superseded by page 1, kept for reference.
A1 RESTRAINED · colour fields + drop cap.
A2 SPIRITED · + repp stripe, varsity numeral, ribbon.
A3 FULL · + crest, margin note, stamped seal.

A — CHALKBOARD
Green-dominant, chalk ground, brass for action.

B — FOOLSCAP
Warm cream, oxblood, hunter green, tobacco.

D — ASSEMBLY HALL
Ivory, mahogany, brass, deep oxblood.

NOTHING ON THIS PAGE IS CHOSEN YET. Four questions are deferred to looking rather than arguing, and each artboard isolates one of them and holds the rest constant.

THE WORDMARK  ·  W1 one line vs W3 stacked letterspaced caps, drawn at hero, rail, auth and 16px. The rail at 252px is the size that decides it.

THE MOTTO  ·  P1 on a band under the shield (a third Crest variant, one call site) vs P2 engraved as its own line beneath the wordmark (no new variant). Hero size only either way. LICET FACERE is never glossed in English anywhere in the product -- D44.

THE PAGE  ·  L1 the mark leads vs L2 the argument leads. Same ground, same mark, same copy; only what the eye lands on first changes.

THE GROUND  ·  G1 paper, G2 rail green, G3 desk. The three L1 artboards are one file emitted three times -- only the four colour variables differ. Two findings are already visible: on green, wine-on-green is a 0.16 lightness step and the button needs a gold hairline; on desk, type is set directly on --desk, which is what app.css's "nothing is ever set on it" comment currently denies. Whichever wins, D46 records it and that comment either survives or goes.

THE COPY IS REAL  ·  "Enroll yourself." over the actual lifecycle -- interview, syllabus you approve, lessons, exam. No lorem ipsum, and no claim about the Harkness teaching method (D44, spec 8.13.7). No pricing, testimonials, feature grid, analytics or email capture (8.13.10).
